competitor.name: Brown & Brown
competitor.description: Premier insurance brokerage firm providing risk management solutions, operating decentralized entrepreneurial branches.

items.title: Brown & Brown Closes Purchase of Florida Coastal Property Specialist
items.summary: Acquired Gulf Coast Coastal Underwriters, adding dedicated hurricane and flood binding authorities across 8 coastal states.

items.title: Brown & Brown Programs Division Unveils National Habitational Program
items.summary: Introduced nationwide multi-family habitational property facility with $150M syndicate capacity backed by Lloyd's.

items.title: Brown & Brown Appoints New President of Retail Brokerage Segment
items.summary: Promoted Steve Hearn to President of Retail Brokerage to deepen middle-market accounts and decentralized sales accountability.

items.title: Brown & Brown Quarterly E&S Index Reflects Coastal Property Pricing Strains
items.summary: Wholesale index tracked 9.8% rate gains in coastal commercial habitational risks with increasing mandatory deductible percentages.

items.title: Brown & Brown Acquires Automotive Dealership F&I Administrator
items.summary: Expanded automotive warranty and finance & insurance advisory via acquisition of Apex Dealer Solutions.

battlecard_template.headline: Decentralized Sales Culture Excels in E&S Programs and Niche Industries
battlecard_template.subtext: Brown & Brown pairs high-commission entrepreneurial local offices with dominant wholesale binding authority in property, automotive, and programs.

wins.title: National Scale with Unified Technology
wins.text: Pitch our consolidated client digital risk portal against Brown & Brown's disparate legacy systems across acquired offices.

wins.title: Transparent Commission vs. High Broker Spreads
wins.text: Demonstrate fee clarity against B&B's aggressive commission and wholesale program spread structures.

wins.title: Dedicated Enterprise Claims Management
wins.text: Win accounts frustrated with B&B branch-level variance in claims handling by highlighting our centralized claims legal team.

moves.summary: Acquired Gulf Coast Coastal Underwriters adding specialized coastal binding authority.
Launched national multi-family habitational property program with Lloyd's syndicate backing.
Named Steve Hearn as President of Retail Brokerage to drive middle-market growth.
